fresh.subject: Unexpected HTTP 429 from API
fresh.description: Our API integration receives HTTP 429 errors on its usual requests; the request volume is unchanged.
fresh.rationale: Normal-load rate limiting; same explicit numeric identifier.

fresh.subject: Card billed twice for monthly plan
fresh.description: Two identical amounts for the same monthly subscription appear on the customer's card statement.
fresh.rationale: Duplicate charge rather than wrong subscription price.

fresh.subject: Verification text never reaches phone
fresh.description: The account has two-factor authentication enabled but SMS verification codes do not arrive on the phone.
fresh.rationale: Missing two-factor SMS, not password recovery.

fresh.subject: Reset password is considered wrong
fresh.description: The customer used the link in the password reset email and reset the password, but the new password is rejected as incorrect.
fresh.rationale: Post-reset rejection remains a valid match.

fresh.subject: Dashboard loading never finishes
fresh.description: The main dashboard remains stuck on a loading spinner that never resolves, including after a page refresh.
fresh.rationale: Indefinite spinner, not general slow response.

fresh.subject: Widgets collide on small display
fresh.description: Dashboard widgets overlap each other on a smaller-resolution laptop and the contents become unreadable.

fresh.subject: Full-year PDF report fails
fresh.description: A full year PDF report export fails with a timeout after approximately 30 seconds.

fresh.subject: Old API key still accepted after regeneration
fresh.description: The API key was regenerated for security reasons, but the previous key still authenticates successful requests.
fresh.rationale: Key revocation delay; not former employee sessions.

fresh.subject: Unfamiliar warehouse connector rejects TLS handshake
fresh.description: A new Teradata warehouse integration cannot negotiate TLS on its first connection. There is no credential rejection.
fresh.rationale: No TLS negotiation incident for unfamiliar integration.

fresh.subject: Password reset message undelivered
fresh.description: I cannot receive the reset email. I requested it several times and checked junk mail but still have no message or link.
fresh.rationale: Delivery failure, not incorrect password after reset.

fresh.subject: Authenticator app token incorrect
fresh.description: The rotating number in my authenticator app is always rejected. The account uses an authenticator app rather than SMS verification.
fresh.rationale: No authenticator-app token rejection incident; SMS delivery differs.

fresh.subject: Credit card company declined subscription payment
fresh.description: My bank declines the subscription payment because the card was frozen. There is no duplicate charge or error saving a payment method.
fresh.rationale: No frozen-card issuer-decline incident; different payment mechanism.
